english_translation: At our home region there are tall mountains that are lovely to see.
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Kwedu' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'kuona' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (ku- (Cl. 15 infinitive / Cl. 17 locative) + -ona (stem)) with tone contour H-L-H.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
